_meta.authority: NON-AUTHORITATIVE. Deterministic structuring of controlled current-state evidence; not a qualification decision and not an authorization. No facts are generated from absence.

summary.note: No system is automatically retained or retired; all target dispositions are UNPROVEN hypotheses.

authority_boundaries.holds: National policy, national program standards, national fee framework, system-of-record intent for club/affiliation/participant master data under the target platform, executive acceptance authority.
authority_boundaries.does_not_hold: Provincial/territorial internal governance; club internal operations.

authority_boundaries.holds: Provincial/territorial jurisdiction over member clubs, provincial requirements and fees, provincial review of club affiliation, appropriate retained jurisdiction under the target platform.
authority_boundaries.does_not_hold: National master-data authority; ability to override national governed decisions.

authority_boundaries.holds: Club-level operations, local membership administration, submission of affiliation and renewal, local facility and roster reality.
Personal identity and participation; may hold several roles (member, volunteer, coach, official, administrator) across clubs/PTSOs concurrently.
authority_boundaries.does_not_hold: Any governed authority beyond assigned roles; role multiplicity must not collapse into a single coarse permission bucket.

system_authority_matrix.name: Curling I/O
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: The House is master-data authority for club, affiliation, and participant records; competition/league standing never overrides governed master data.

system_authority_matrix.name: Current registration provider (incumbent)
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: Authoritative for legacy data only during transition; authority expires on an explicit recorded migration-completion (cutover) trigger.

system_authority_matrix.name: Payment processors
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: Governed decision to charge, fee policy, and resulting record remain in The House; explicit reconciliation boundary with accounting (SYS-008).

system_authority_matrix.name: Sideline Learning
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: The House projects status and governs its use, not the underlying record
system_authority_matrix.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN as external system of record (unproven)

system_authority_matrix.name: Accreditation platforms
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: The House projects status and governs its use, not the record
system_authority_matrix.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN as external system of record (unproven)

system_authority_matrix.name: Analytics platforms
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: Consumes projected data only; MUST NOT become a system of record

system_authority_matrix.name: Accounting systems
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: The House synchronizes and does not overwrite the ledger; explicit boundary with payment processors (SYS-003).
system_authority_matrix.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN as financial system of record (unproven)

system_authority_matrix.name: Support systems (Halo / Zendesk where relevant)
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: Support cases reference but do not own governed records

system_authority_matrix.name: Identity and Microsoft 365 services
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: Email/shared-file processes are manual controls, not governed systems of record; risk of shadow authority.
system_authority_matrix.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETAIN for identity/productivity; do not treat as SoR (unvalidated)

system_authority_matrix.name: Manual spreadsheets and shared files
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: A recurring reconciliation and data-quality risk; duplicate copies without a single authoritative source.

system_authority_matrix.name: Email-mediated processes
system_authority_matrix.reconciliation: Decisions and evidence live outside a governed store; audit and evidence binding are weak.
system_authority_matrix.target_disposition_hypothesis: RETIRE / replace with governed evidence binding (unvalidated)
